name: winona-sun-worn-party
checks: C384 v3.8 Above the storm, the design hypothesis (worn): the Designer's yardstick HOUNDOOM 31 / PUPITAR 33 / MANECTRIC 31 at hpPercent 50, no bag, fights WINONA on a fixed line (OVERHEAT until SKARMORY falls, switch to PUPITAR, then slot 1; OVERHEAT's 5 PP can't be spammed) (TRAINER_WINONA_1). Her intro has the new line 'Storms never climb this high.'; the battle opens in harsh sun (include/trainer_battle_weather.h, GetBattleStartWeather) with TROPIUS 31 in front, and the sun is still up when the fight ends (permanent). PASS for the beat = the worn party loses at least one Pokémon (expectBattleSummary minPlayerFaints 1); the numbers are in report.json battleSummaries.

expectText: Let me show you how they've grown!

steps.comment: the yardstick's line: OVERHEAT (5 PP) until SKARMORY falls, then switch the spent HOUNDOOM (SP. ATK -4) out for PUPITAR, as a player would; then spam slot 1

until: Never before have I seen a TRAINER
